messages:
Maria Santos: Quick heads-up — running a CRM admin sandbox sweep this week to catch any healthscore drift after playbook automation pushes. Plan: weekly snapshot of healthscore by account cohort, flag cohorts with >10% median shift, run delta query, if regression confirmed open playbook rollback PR and notify owners. Volunteers to validate sampling logic + metadata mapping?

Aj Patel: I can help with the sampling logic. Do you want stratified sampling by ARR band + onboarding stage?

Tara Nguyen: Yes please. Also need to ensure trial->paid mapping is correct; last time a bot changed the 'onboarded' tag we saw false positives.

Dmitri Ivanov: I'll run an exploratory query tonight. Pasting SQL I usually use:
```
SELECT cohort_id, median(healthscore) as med_score, COUNT(*) as n
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE last_touch > now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY cohort_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;
```
Then compare against last_snapshot table and compute pct_diff.

Dmitri Ivanov: Note: our tag normalization changed in 2025-11; mapping is in /docs/data/tag-mapping.csv

ops-bot: Scheduled job 'crm_health_snapshot' will run 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC — triggered by Maria Santos :calendar:

Ellie Park: Can we wire an automated Datadog monitor to alert on pct_diff > 10% and include sample accounts + top contributing events? saves manual triage.

Aj Patel: yes — I'll add a monitor. Which fields should we include in the event payload? I suggest account_id, cohort_id, med_score_old, med_score_new, top_tags

Pranav Shah: Also add 'last_playbook_id' and 'last_playbook_change_ts' so we can correlate regressions to recent automation pushes.

Maria Santos: perfect. I'll update the runbook here: https://redwood-internal.link/runbooks/cs/crm-health-playbook-sweep

Tara Nguyen: FYI I'll audit the 'onboarded' tag mappings tomorrow and post any fixes.

Dmitri Ivanov: Ran a dry run — found one cohort with -12% median shift tied to a webhook duplicate. Saved results to /shared/cs/healthsweep/1716549876/dryrun.csv

Ellie Park: :eyes: good catch. If webhook duplicates are the root cause we should add dedupe step to playbook automation.

Aj Patel: I'll draft an alert + a playbook checklist item for dedupe steps.

Maria Santos: Thanks all — tagging @Data Team for awareness. Will reconvene after the scheduled job runs.

Data Team: noted. We'll standby to help with queries or to reindex if needed.
